messages:
elaine: Quick sync — PR #4827 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4827) is ready for reviewer-lane assignment. It's a doc + SDK snippet update for the new batching ROI section. Need approvals and the docs-preview to be green before the v1.5 cutover on 2026-04-01. Who can own reviews and watch CI?
samir: I can review the SDK snippet and the batching guidance. Will look today.
lucy: I can do the product/clarity pass. Please ping me when CI is green.
jon: I'll double-check links and versioning. Noticed earlier that previews sometimes break for branch-based versions.
elaine: thanks — two quick constraints: 1) this must be merged into `v1.5` branch (not main) to pick up versioned docs, 2) feature flag `realtime-batching` rollout is scheduled same day so README must call out the gated behavior.
samir: noted on `v1.5`. For the ff note, do we want a short snippet like: "This feature is gated by feature flag `realtime-batching`; contact infra to enable for Dedicated"?
lucy: yes, but add recommended fallback behavior for older customers. One line will do.
jon: CI note — docs-preview is currently failing on relative runtime links. Error in the static build: `ERROR: BrokenLink: docs/runtimes/ -> 404`. I have a quick fix (adjust `mkdocs.yml` base_url for branch previews).
docs-bot: build #1204 for PR 4827 started (preview URL: https://deploy-preview-4827--docs.redwood.ai). Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/1204
ci-bot: build #1204 failed: BrokenLink in /runtimes/ (see logs).
elaine: Okay. Jon — can you push your mkdocs tweak as a small commit to the PR and tag me? That should unblock preview.
jon: Pushed `fix/preview-baseurl` to the PR — small change to `mkdocs.yml`.
ci-bot: re-run requested by jon — queued.
docs-bot: build #1205 for PR 4827 started (preview URL: https://deploy-preview-4827--docs.redwood.ai).
ci-bot: build #1205 succeeded — preview live.
samir: Reviewed SDK snippet — left one inline suggestion about using `client.optimize()` vs `client.batchify()` in the snippet. Small semantics.
lucy: Clarity pass done — reworded one sentence and added the fallback note.
elaine: Great. Can we get two approvals total? Samir + Lucy? If so I'll merge into `v1.5` after midnight PT to avoid release window.
samir: Approved. :+1:
lucy: Approved. :rocket:
elaine: One more checklist: tagging release notes author (cc @maria) and ensuring the ff rollout docs reference the rollout schedule. We should also add a changelog line under V1.5 -> "batching ROI and gated realtime batching".
jon: added changelog line and pinged maria.
docs-bot: PR 4827 labels updated: `approved`, `v1.5`, `release-candidate`.
elaine: Merging into `v1.5` now. Will monitor canary deploy and the feature flag rollout. If the flag toggles fail, we'll revert the docs change (it's gated so safe).
docs-bot: PR 4827 merged into `v1.5` by elaine at 1945679040.
elaine: Thanks everyone — if anyone sees missing links in the live site, please open a follow-up PR and tag `docs-oncall`.
samir: noted. Thanks!
lucy: thanks all :tada:
